rawRetro.summary: Built the internal IT ticket feature end to end on the current template baseline: one tickets migration, idempotent seeds for two permission sets, three accounts and three tickets, an authorization-scoped server service and /api/tickets routes, and a Tickets page with status filtering and a URL-addressable detail. Added an integration test covering authentication, employee/handler scoping, create, start, complete and repeat-transition rejection. typecheck, lint, prettier, the focused vitest files, `pnpm build` and a real `pnpm db:apply` against an isolated SQLite database all pass. Repair round: made the tickets service provider tolerate an absent authorization plugin so the template's app-server runtime test boots with plugins disabled.

blockers.title: A seed importing a shared application module fails to load under Vitest
blockers.symptom: Bootstrapping the app from tests/logic/tickets.test.ts failed with `AppDatabaseTaskError: Database seeds failed ... Cannot find module '.../database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from .../202609010003_tickets_permissions.ts`. The same seed applied fine through `pnpm db:apply` and in a compiled build.
blockers.rootCause: The database task loader imports a seed .ts file with a native dynamic import. Under Vitest the seed is loaded through Vite's module runner, which resolved the seed's relative `../../seed-data/permission-sets.js` specifier against the filesystem instead of mapping `.js` to the sibling `.ts` source. `tsx` (used by the CLI) performs that mapping, so only the test path exposed it.
blockers.resolution: Made the permissions seed self-contained: the grant field allowlists and identifiers are written out inside the seed file, and the shared database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts module was removed. This also matches the rule that a seed records what was granted at one time and must not follow a later change to a shared field list.

blockers.title: Cookie-authenticated writes are rejected in tests without a trusted Origin
blockers.symptom: POST /api/tickets returned 403 `{"code":"INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN"}` even though GET and sign-in worked.
blockers.rootCause: `authentication.required()` calls the authentication plugin's `checkCookieWriteOrigin` for any non-GET request carrying a cookie. It accepts the Origin/Referer only when Better Auth trusts it. Better Auth derives trusted origins from its baseURL, which the plugin sets from `app.publicOrigin`; the test config did not set it, so no origin was trusted.
blockers.resolution: Set `app.publicOrigin` in the test's isolated config and send a matching Origin header on every request from the test helper. Verified the production path separately: `pnpm build` plus `pnpm db:apply` against a temp SQLite file ran migrations and seeds cleanly and idempotently.

blockers.title: Application tickets provider boot required the authorization plugin, failing the plugin-less runtime test
blockers.symptom: tests/logic/app-server.test.ts > "registers application-owned providers and routes from the runtime" failed at app.start() with `Error: Service "@nocobase/app/authorization" is not registered.` raised from TicketsProvider.boot (server/providers/tickets/index.ts).
blockers.rootCause: `TicketsProvider.boot()` unconditionally resolved `authorizationToken` to register the tickets collection, page and record-access scope. That test spreads the application runtime (which now includes the tickets provider) but overrides `plugins` with an empty list, so the authorization plugin's provider never registers the token and the resolve throws. Application providers are expected to boot independently of which plugins are enabled; the authorization plugin's own provider guards its optional realtime service the same way.
blockers.resolution: Guarded `TicketsProvider.boot()` with `this.app.container.has(authorizationToken)` and returned early when the authorization plugin is not present, matching the plugin's own optional-dependency idiom. Production is unchanged because the authorization plugin is always registered there; the ticket routes still resolve the same token and are only mounted when the plugin is present. `pnpm exec vitest run tests/logic/app-server.test.ts` (27 passed) and `tests/logic/tickets.test.ts` (1 passed) confirm both the plugin-less boot and the real feature; `tsc -p tsconfig.server.json`, eslint and prettier on the changed file all pass.

improvements.title: Seed loader cannot resolve a relative .js specifier back to its .ts source
improvements.detail: An application seed that imports another application TypeScript module via the project's `.js` ESM convention loads under `tsx` and in a compiled build, but not when a test boots the app through the standalone server. The failure appears only on the test path, late in startup, and the error names the compiled specifier rather than the source of the convention.
improvements.suggestedChange: In `@nocobase/db`'s task loader (or the standalone/Vitest module resolution it uses), map a relative `./x.js` specifier to `./x.ts` when no `.js` sibling exists, matching `tsx` and the TypeScript `moduleResolution: bundler` behavior. Alternatively, document in the application development Skill that seeds must stay import-free so the restriction is discoverable before it fails a test run.

evaluation.summary: 本次 IT 工单案例直接检验了 NocoBase3 的授权模型、数据库/Repository、服务与路由装配、认证沿用和客户端页面注册五个基础能力单元。框架职责范围内的记录范围策略、以期望状态为谓词的更新、类型化路由与 provider/token 装配均能直接支撑需求；应用按指引落地后员工越权读返回 404、员工推进返回 403、重复完成返回 409，浏览器验收 B01–B05 通过。主要缺口在指引组合层：authorization 的 code-and-seeds 参考推荐 seed 导入共享 permission-set 模块，而 @nocobase/db 载入器在 Vitest 启动路径无法把相对 .js 解析回 .ts，nocobase-db Skill 又要求 seed 自包含，形成互相冲突且要等启动失败才暴露的指引；另有应用 provider 对未安装可选插件缺少装配提示。视觉评审因当前模型无法读取 PNG 而未进行。

modules.name: 授权模型与记录范围
modules.scope: 员工只读自己提交的工单、处理人员读全部、页面授权与数据授权分离、状态推进的服务端授权与拒绝语义。
modules.limitations: 未逐行核对授权匹配引擎 authorizer.js 的 grant 解析；未评估 default-access/sharing/restriction 规则插件；R01/R03 的浏览器端只依赖已归档 QA 记录。

requirements.need: 员工只能读取自己提交的工单，服务端强制，不按用户名硬编码，不只是隐藏按钮。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供可注册的记录范围策略、可持久化的 permission set 与按请求求值的 Repository Policy；应用负责声明 submitterId 范围并写入授权数据。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 在 owning provider 中用 defineRecordAccess 注册自定义范围，seed 持久化 permission set 与分配，路由以 policyFor+withPolicy 执行。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 定义 tickets.submitted 范围并在 provider 注册，seed 写入 it-employee/it-handler 两套 permission set；员工读取他人工单返回 404，伪造 submitterId 被忽略。

requirements.need: 页面访问与数据访问分离；处理人员能读到全部测试工单。
requirements.responsibility: 框架区分 page grant 与 database.collection grant；应用负责为两类 job 选择页面与数据动作。
requirements.recommendedUsage: authz.pages.add 注册页面，permissionSet 分别授予 page:access 与集合读/写动作，路由侧不依赖页面可见性。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 provider 注册 collection/page，seed 中 it-handler 用 allRecords 读全部，页面路由 name=tickets 由默认页面检查控制可见。

requirements.need: 处理人员“开始处理/完成”是类型化动作，服务端检查授权与状态；已完成只读，员工不能推进状态；三个状态不必引入 Workflow。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 update 授权决策、带策略的 Repository 与以期望状态为条件的更新；应用负责状态机与字段规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 以自定义路由 + authentication.required + authorization.middleware，policy.update 为 false 直接 403，updateOne 的 filter 带当前状态，RECORD_NOT_FOUND 映射为冲突。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的 /tickets/:id/start、/complete 先检查 policy.update，再以 filter {id,status:from} 更新，重复完成返回 409；未使用 Workflow。

requirementFit.reason: R01/R03 的服务端记录范围、页面/数据分离与状态流转均由现有能力直接支持：defineRecordAccess 提供可校验的自定义范围，policyFor 把请求授权折叠为 Repository Policy，provider 注册与 seed 持久化职责清晰；应用据此落地后越权读 404、员工推进 403。

usability.reason: policyFor 一次折叠四个决策、withPolicy 直接绑定，注册顺序与 seed 边界在 Skill 中说明；但内置 recordsIOwn 固定 ownerId，本表必须自写 scope，增加了必要但非零的接入代码。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 明确要求注册 collection/scope、逐条路由鉴权、把业务状态写进 mutation 谓词，并给出 seed 持久化模式；扣分点在与 db Skill 冲突的 seed 导入建议（见 F2）。

design.reason: 记录范围是可持久化的策略数据，defineRecordAccess/RecordAccessRegistry 与 Repository Policy 边界清晰，permission set 只产出值、可在后台编辑，不把角色判断塞进路由。

reliability.reason: 实现层 Registry.add 拒绝重复/空 key 与非法 resources，resolve 拒绝未知或不适用策略；policyFor 对 deny 折叠为 false 并只做结构转换，本次测试覆盖 403/404/409 拒绝路径。

modules.name: 数据库、迁移与 Repository 策略
modules.scope: 单张工单表的 schema 迁移、安装种子、运行时读写与带策略、带期望状态的更新语义。
modules.limitations: 未验证 SQLite 以外的方言；未查看迁移历史/checksum 实现的全部路径；seed 导入缺口只在归档日志与载入器代码层面确认。

requirements.responsibility: 框架负责迁移声明 schema、Repository 负责运行时持久化；应用负责字段与业务值。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineMigration 的 builder.createCollection 建表，运行时代码经 databaseManagerToken 用 Repository 读写。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的迁移建立 tickets 表与索引，service 用 findMany/createOne/updateOne，浏览器刷新与 QA 均通过。

requirements.need: 状态迁移以期望状态为谓词，重复完成被拒绝，已完成只读。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供带策略的更新与单条更新失败语义；应用负责状态机。
requirements.recommendedUsage: withPolicy 后 updateOne 的 filter 含当前状态，捕获 RECORD_NOT_FOUND 映射为业务冲突。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的 transition 用 filter {id,status:from}，并把 RECORD_NOT_FOUND 转成 409 INVALID_TRANSITION。

requirements.need: 种子幂等且可重复执行，安装数据真实落库。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 seed 载入、事务与幂等约定；应用负责稳定业务键与写入内容。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db 要求 seed 自包含、以稳定键幂等；authorization 参考则示例 import database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts 后写库。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 先按 authorization 参考把 permission-set 值抽到共享模块，应用启动测试即报 Cannot find module permission-sets.js，随后改为在 seed 内联字段清单。

requirementFit.reason: 单表迁移、Repository 读写与以期望状态为谓词的更新链均由 @nocobase/db 直接支持；应用迁移、种子与 updateOne({filter:{id,status:from}}) 落地后刷新持久、重复完成 409。

usability.reason: withPolicy 与 RECORD_NOT_FOUND 语义清楚，迁移/种子示例完整；但 seed 共享模块导入在测试启动路径失败，迫使自包含改写（见 F1）。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 对 Repository/Query 边界和 self-contained 规则写得很细，但与 authorization 参考组合时自相矛盾，且载入器直到 boot 才报错，正确写法要靠失败后推断（见 F1/F2）。

design.reason: 策略节点在 enforce.js 中统一解析与相交，期望状态谓词放在 mutation 而非先读后写，迁移/种子/运行时代码分层明确。

reliability.reason: enforce.js 在查看输入前因策略 false 直接拒绝，combinePolicyFilter 以 and 相交调用方与策略范围；updateOne 将 adapter 的 missing 映射为 RECORD_NOT_FOUND，应用据此返回 409。

modules.name: 服务装配与 HTTP 路由

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/server-routes.md

Enforce record, field and relation policies

modules.scope: 工单 API 端点的注册与鉴权、领域服务经 token 装配、路由与领域逻辑分层。

requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 defineApiRoutes 建 /tickets 子路由并挂 auth.required+authz.middleware，匿名请求 401 已由测试确认。

requirements.responsibility: 框架提供 provider+token 的依赖装配；应用拆分 service。

requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 ServiceProvider 绑定 ticketsServiceToken，TicketsService 只返回 domain 结果，TicketsError 在路由 onError 转 HTTP。

requirementFit.reason: defineApiRoutes 与 ServiceProvider/token 直接支撑认证后的类型化业务端点与独立领域服务：路由只做 HTTP 与错误映射，service 经 token 解析，匿名 401、员工越权动作 403。

modules.name: 认证与会话沿用
modules.scope: 沿用既有登录/用户/会话，准备测试账号，处理带 cookie 写请求的 CSRF 边界。
modules.limitations: 未验证 OAuth/找回密码/禁用用户等路径；未运行真实浏览器 CSRF 失败复现，只依据文档、实现与归档日志。

requirements.need: 沿用现有用户与权限能力，不建第二套身份系统，复用工厂测试密码。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责身份、凭据、会话存储与密码哈希；应用负责账号清单与初始分配。
requirements.recommendedUsage: users.initialAdmin 只引导初始管理员，后续账号用用户管理服务；seed 可复用框架默认管理员 seed 的 user/account 写入方式。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的 users seed 用 better-auth hashPassword 写入 user/account 并读 users.initialAdmin 密码，与框架自带默认管理员 seed 完全同构，登录与 QA 通过。

requirements.need: 带 cookie 的写请求需要可信 Origin，测试/部署要配置 publicOrigin。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 CSRF 校验与从 publicOrigin 派生可信源；应用/测试负责配置正确 Origin。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 部署设置 app.publicOrigin，额外前端源用 auth.trustedOrigins；测试请求携带匹配 Origin。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的集成测试最初 POST 返回 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN，按文档设置 app.publicOrigin 并补 Origin 头后通过。

requirementFit.reason: 沿用既有 Authentication 的 user/account/session，未引入第二套身份：authenticationToken + auth.required 直接可用，seed 账号复用 users.initialAdmin 密码并采用与框架默认管理员 seed 相同的写入方式。

usability.reason: 登录、cookie 写请求与 CSRF 行为由插件统一处理，guidance 对 publicOrigin/trustedOrigins 说明具体；agent 依据文档设置后测试通过。

agentFriendliness.reason: user-lifecycle 文档明确 INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN 的触发条件与修法，SKILL 说明 initialAdmin 只用于初始管理员，使 agent 能在失败后自行恢复。

design.reason: Authentication 负责身份/凭据/会话，Authorization 负责授权，边界清晰；初始管理员通过配置与 seed 引导，后续账号变更走用户管理服务。

reliability.reason: 实现从 app.publicOrigin 派生 Better Auth baseURL 与 cookie 前缀，框架自带默认管理员 seed 对 user/account 的写入与校验同文档一致；本次未跑真实浏览器的 CSRF 拒绝路径。

client visibility never replaces server enforcement

requirements.responsibility: 框架负责路由注册、页面授权检查与 HTTP 客户端；应用负责页面内容与查询参数。

findings.title: Seed 动态导入无法把相对 .js 指示符解析回 .ts 源，破坏应用启动测试
findings.detail: task-loader.importTaskDefinition 用原生动态 import 加载 seed 文件，@nocobase/db 的 __rewriteRelativeImportExtension 只作用于任务文件自身的 URL；seed 内部的 '../../seed-data/permission-sets.js' 交由 Node/Vitest 解析，找不到同名 .js 时抛 AppDatabaseTaskError。Agent 依 authorization 参考写出共享模块后，仅在测试启动路径失败（pnpm db:apply 的 tsx 与编译构建正常）。
findings.impact: 应用按参考组织 seed 数据时，模板的 app-server 运行测试无法 boot，必须把 seed 改写成自包含文件才能通过。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 @nocobase/db 的 seed/migration 载入器把相对 .js 解析到实际存在的 .ts（或在 Vitest 集成层注册同等解析），并在 nocobase-db Skill 中写明该限制。

findings.claimed: code-and-seeds.md 以示例声明 seed 位于 database/main/seeds 并 import database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts，暗示这是可直接采用的初始配置写法。
findings.observed: 同一仓库的 nocobase-db Skill 要求 seed self-contained、不得 import 共享常量；而 @nocobase/db 载入器在 Vitest 路径无法解析该相对导入，按示例写会 boot 失败。
findings.title: 两份 Skill 对 seed 是否可导入共享模块给出冲突指引
findings.detail: authorization 的 code-and-seeds 参考把 permission-set 值放在独立模块并在 seed 中导入；nocobase-db Skill 的 self-contained 规则明确禁止导入会演进的 Collection/模型/共享常量。两条都是被评指引，组合使用时正确写法只能靠一次失败的 boot 推断。
findings.impact: Agent 按其中一份指引实现就可能违反另一份并在测试启动阶段失败，增加试错成本与不一致的 seed 组织方式。
findings.suggestedChange: 统一口径：要么让载入器支持该导入，要么在 authorization 参考中把 seed-data 导入标注为仅构建/tsx 可用并给出自包含替代片段。

findings.title: 缺少应用 provider 容忍未安装可选插件的装配指引
findings.detail: authorization Skill 要求 provider 在 boot 解析依赖，services-and-jobs 只列生命周期阶段；两份指引都未说明可选插件 token 可能不存在。Agent 的 TicketsProvider.boot 无条件 resolve authorizationToken，在模板禁插件的 app-server 运行测试中报 Service not registered，需自行改为 container.has() 早退。
findings.impact: 按推荐 provider 模式开发的应用在插件裁剪或测试矩阵下启动失败，且错误信息不指向缺少可选依赖，增加定位成本。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 services-and-jobs 或 authorization Skill 的 provider 章节补充：boot 解析可选插件 token 前用 container.has 判断并优雅降级。

findings.title: 记录范围策略与 Repository 策略链把服务端授权做成可持久化数据而非路由分支
findings.detail: defineRecordAccess/RecordAccessRegistry 提供可校验的自定义记录范围，permissionSet 只产出值，policyFor 把 read/create/update/delete 折叠为 Repository Policy，enforce.js 在读写前拒绝并以 and 相交 filter。Agent 用 tickets.submitted 与两套 permission set 落地，服务端对越权读返回 404、员工 start 返回 403、重复 complete 返回 409。
findings.impact: 应用无需在路由写角色 if 判断，权限可由管理员在后台编辑，且拒绝语义在服务端统一。

ui.reason: 已尝试读取 B01-after-refresh、B05-employeeA-list-completed、B02-employee2-list 三张 PNG，但当前评审模型不支持图像输入，无法据此判断跨页面样式一致性，故不做视觉评分。

evidence.observation: RecordAccessRegistry.add 校验 key 唯一、resolver 必填、resources 合法；resolve() 对未知或不适用的记录范围抛错；defineRecordAccess 要求 key 并强制至少一个 resource。

evidence.excerpt:
1. Declare schema and relationships through self-contained migrations. Choose stable resource, page and scope names. Keep authorization decisions out of migration code.
2. Declare reusable data permissions with `defineDatabasePermission`; compose user-facing actions with `defineAuthorizationResource`. Explicitly name fields, relation capabilities and every table touched by a workflow.
3. Register collections, pages, flat resource groups, resources and record-access strategies in the owning provider. Resolve dependencies at boot and release subject registrations at shutdown.
4. Protect every server route with authentication. For a simple single-scope Repository operation, retain `defineRepositoryApiRoutes` and add `authz.db.authorizeRepository` to map methods to business actions; it reuses or initializes the request authorization scope. For workflows, persisted-state checks, multiple scopes or custom responses, use a custom handler with `authz.middleware()`, call the request scope's `authorize()` once and apply every returned table policy using `repository.withPolicy()`. Follow the selection criteria and complete code in [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md).
5. Add page authorization and `useCan` for action visibility. Obtain per-record eligibility from the server when needed. Handle pending/error states without displaying stale access.
6. Complete the accompanying permission configuration from the responsibility matrix: sets, page/action grants, selected scopes, supported rules and intended assignments. Use seeds for fresh installations and authorized provisioning for existing installations; do not assume editing a seed updates a running App. Resolve optional capabilities through their installed Skills and preserve unrelated administrator edits.
7. Verify denied as well as allowed requests through the production route factory and actual database policies. Then verify the UI with ordinary users and inherited memberships.

## Enforcement rules

- Register collections explicitly with `authz.db.collections.add({ name, title, actions? })`. Metadata comes from DB; registration grants nothing. Unregistered collections are denied even to unrestricted users.
- Business groups compose database capabilities; administration groups compose settings/system capabilities. Page grants are separate. Page visibility never authorizes a server endpoint.
- `can` is for feature visibility. `require`/`guard` require unconditional permission and reject conditional decisions. Composed business endpoints use `authorize`, reject denial/missing policies, and consume `conditions.database` without resolving aggregate grants again.
- For simple business CRUD, keep the original Repository route definition and use `db.authorizeRepository` to bind each method to its business action. Follow [Repository route integration](references/repository-routes.md). Multi-scope actions and workflow transitions require custom handlers. `db.policyFor` aggregates collection grants; it does not define a business-action boundary.
- Scope every read and write in the workflow, including parent lookups. Keep multi-record writes transactional and include expected business state in mutation predicates. Authorization does not validate a quote's amount or its workflow transition.
- Fields and relation operations are code-owned. The permission workspace configures business operations, their scopes and pages; do not build a second raw-field permission editor.
- Relation writes do not inherit the target collection's standalone constraints. Declare target record access and join-table fields explicitly; prevent foreign-key fields from bypassing association controls.
- Request scopes cache rules and grants. Reuse one within a request; create a new one for a new request/identity. Do not persist authorization decisions in module state.

evidence.excerpt:
Each context carries its own tools, and which one to use is not a free choice — see [Repository and Query](#4-repository-and-query). In short: a migration works through `builder` and `query`, and a seed writes through `repository`.

The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm db:redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Both run inside a transaction by default. `transaction: false` opts out, and a failure then leaves partial work behind with no history record, so take it only when the operation genuinely cannot run in one.

evidence.excerpt:
**Public origin.** Set `app.publicOrigin` to the HTTPS address the browser
sees. Better Auth derives its base URL and callback URLs from it and from the
application's public base path; a container-internal address breaks OAuth
callbacks and cookie attributes. The reverse proxy must forward host,
protocol, and cookies.

**Business request CSRF.** `Auth.required()` and `Auth.optional()` reject cookie-bearing writes unless `Origin` (or, when absent, `Referer`) matches Better Auth's configured base origin or a trusted origin. Configure `app.publicOrigin` for deployed applications and add separate frontend origins through `auth.trustedOrigins`; without a trusted origin, browser writes fail closed with `INVALID_CSRF_ORIGIN`. Cookie-free API key requests can proceed after authentication. A credential header does not exempt a request carrying cookies, including routes that skip session lookup.

## Initial administrator

Before the first seed run, set `users.initialAdmin.username` and `users.initialAdmin.password` in application configuration to customize the bootstrap account. Omitting the entire node preserves `nocobase/admin123`; an explicit node requires a nonempty password and defaults the username to `nocobase`. Usernames contain 3–30 letters, digits, underscores or dots and are stored lowercase; the email remains `admin@nocobase.com`. Initialization only runs when the user table is empty, hashes the password and grants the newly created account root permission through the authorization plugin. After initialization, configuration changes do not reset accounts or rerun the recorded seeds. The root permission seed selects the administrator by the same configured username. Use the user administration service for subsequent account changes. Do not edit historical seeds or add a competing administrator seed.

evidence.excerpt:
Descendants inherit their entry route’s auth mode and cannot switch it. Authenticated App pages without a page ancestor retain the default `{ resource: { type: 'page', id: name }, action: 'access' }` check; nested pages add a check only when they declare `authz`. Every parent check must pass before its children render. Registration normalizes every route to an explicit `authz` request or `'skip'`; menus, page loaders, and permission discovery consume that result. Omitted authorization on Settings, Dev, guest, and optional pages resolves to `'skip'`. An explicit request is checked independently of `auth`. Route groups cannot declare `authz`.

### Opting a page out of authorization

`authz: 'skip'` skips only the current page's authorization check. Its authentication mode, parent guards, and server authorization still apply.

evidence.excerpt:
The authorization provider clears the permission snapshot before rendering a new session. Route navigation and page guards subscribe to the authorization revision; preserve these checks when customizing the shell so account changes and permission updates take effect without a reload. Pending checks hide protected content, and failed checks deny access.

## Checking feature visibility

Use `useCan` from `@nocobase/app-plugin-authorization/client` for buttons and other permission-dependent UI: `useCan({ resource: { type: 'page', id: 'orders' }, action: 'access' })`. Its `{ can, isPending, error, retry }` result follows the current session and realtime permission updates; pending and failed checks do not allow access. Non-React consumers resolve `authorizationClientToken` and call `client.can({ resource, action })`. Page guards and navigation use this authorization client directly, without Refine permission hooks. Route `authz` declarations use the same `{ resource: { type, id }, action }` request; no string adapter is involved. Client visibility never replaces authorization on the endpoint.
